summary: S9-001 is fixed: the current pure evaluator independently retains blocked, material, critical, authority-override, and hidden-default evidence, while structural adjudication gives source-blocked status precedence. Thresholds, recurring-root detection, the 23-unit clean sample, and full-escalation gates behaved as specified in bounded probes. Two decision-report enumeration gaps remain.

candidate1Reproduction.fixture: RULE:FND-001 had material plus blocked rows and material-error status; RULE:FND-002 had critical plus blocked rows and source-blocked status.

pureEvaluatorEvidence.detail: Final status and every discrepancy row are inspected independently; critical, material, blocked, authority, hidden-default, and root-cause sets are populated without result-status masking.
Recurring roots, all failure gates, and full-audit escalation are derived from those independent sets.

structuralPrecedenceEvidence.detail: A source-blocked derivation must have a blocked comparison row, and a blocked derivation or row requires source-blocked status before critical/material status checks.

The valid mixed critical+blocked fixture passed with source-blocked status and zero structural failures; changing only adjudication/progress to critical-error was rejected with RULE:FND-001: blocked status mismatch.

findings.claim: The incomplete decision branch drops already-final source blockers, affected-family reporting, and the unaudited-population boundary; the complete branch omits the required empty unfinished-unit enumeration.

evidence.detail: The executable gate says the decision report always enumerates blockers, affected families, unfinished units, and the unaudited population boundary.
The early incomplete return contains unfinishedUnitIds but no sourceBlockedUnitIds, affectedFamilyEscalationCandidates, or approximately-199 unaudited boundary.
The complete return contains source-blocker, affected-family, and unaudited-boundary fields but no unfinishedUnitIds field, even when it should be an empty list.

findings.impact: This cannot create a false pass because the incomplete decision remains decisionReady=false, but it violates the frozen reporting contract and can hide an already-known blocker from an interim published decision.
findings.requiredFix: Build the common enumeration fields before the unfinished early return and emit unfinishedUnitIds, sourceBlockedUnitIds, affectedFamilyEscalationCandidates, and the unaudited-population claim boundary in both branches, using empty arrays where applicable.
findings.requiredTest: Add a pure-evaluator case with one final source-blocked unit and one compared unit, and assert all four enumeration fields; also assert unfinishedUnitIds is [] in a complete decision.

findings.claim: A recurring material root confined to core concise-rule/FAQ units correctly forces full-audit escalation but produces an empty affected-family list.

evidence.detail: A root recurs at three audited units or across two source/component families.
A recurring root requires full-audit escalation and the decision report always enumerates affected families.
The evaluator retains root-to-unit and root-to-family maps and correctly detects both recurrence forms.
Full escalation includes recurring roots, but affected families are built only from critical, component-material, authority, and hidden-default unit sets; recurring core-material units are excluded.
The existing recurring-root test uses two sampled components and asserts only the recurring ID, leaving the core-family enumeration path uncovered.

findings.impact: The full-audit requirement is not masked, so the gate still fails safely; however, the affected-family enumeration is false-empty exactly when recurrence is the escalation reason.
findings.requiredFix: For each recurring root, union root_units[root] into the unit set used to derive affected families (or derive affected families directly from root_families[root]) before publishing the decision.
findings.requiredTest: Add same-family three-core-unit and concise-rule-plus-FAQ shared-root cases asserting recurringDefectPatterns, fullAuditEscalationRequired, and the exact affected family list.

verifiedBehaviors.criticalAuthorityDefaultGates: A source-blocked result containing authority-inversion, hidden-default, critical, and blocked rows populated all four failure lists and required full escalation.
verifiedBehaviors.blockedMaterialCriticalCoexistence: Candidate 1 lost one blocker and one critical observation; the current evaluator retained both blockers, the critical unit, and the core material unit simultaneously.
verifiedBehaviors.coreAndComponentLimits: Core material remained a failure even with a synthetic repaired-verified resolution in the focused suite. Two isolated component material units stayed within the declared limit with affected family room; three produced all three over-limit IDs and full escalation.
verifiedBehaviors.recurringRoots: Three audited units in one family and two audited units across concise-rule/FAQ families both produced RC-RECURRING and full escalation.
verifiedBehaviors.cleanSample: The all-clean fixture selected exactly 23 unique units; the existing missing-family test rejects a 22-unit sample.
verifiedBehaviors.structuralStatusPrecedence: Mixed critical+blocked rows accept only source-blocked adjudication status; critical-error was rejected.
verifiedBehaviors.sourceBlockedGate: A complete source-blocked fixture failed the pass gate and enumerated RULE:FND-001.

testsRun.result: passed; reproduced candidate-1 masking, verified current pure evaluation and structural precedence, and reproduced both report-enumeration findings

residualRisks: Stable rootCauseId assignment is structurally required, but semantic attempts to split one real cause into cosmetically different IDs cannot be detected mechanically and remain a verifier/integrator responsibility.
The pure evaluator assumes structurally validated, complete result/comparison maps; the command-line path supplies that precondition by running validate_correctness_audit.validate first.
